steps.sub: casts every field to its real type

steps.label: Dedup on installation_id + reading_timestamp
steps.sub: removes retried Kinesis deliveries before anything downstream sees them

code:
# Kinesis + Lambda is at-least-once -- a retried batch
# can redeliver the same reading. installation_id +
# reading_timestamp is obviously enough to identify one
# reading, so that's what we dedupe on.
clean_df = typed_df.dropDuplicates(
    ["installation_id", "reading_timestamp"]
)
caption: One inverter can't produce two readings at the same instant -- a reasonable, deliberate call.

eyebrow: Write and catalog the curated output
code:
clean_df.write.mode("append") \
  .partitionBy("installation_id") \
  .parquet("s3://caldera-lake-curated/inverter_events_clean/")

# cataloged by a second Glue Crawler as
# caldera_energy.inverter_events_clean
caption: Partitioned by installation_id -- the column every downstream query actually filters on.
